title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms — Expiry, Extension and Exhausted Passes
content:
**Expiry.** Unused visits of a prepaid Tailwise Grooming Salon pass lapse after the pass's expiry date and are not refunded. When a pass passes its expiry date with visits unused it becomes expired, its unused visits are set to zero, and it closes on the day after the expiry date.

**Extension.** The pass status is active when the extension is requested. Where the pass offers an expiry extension, the customer may ask once for an extension of the pass's extension length in days, added to the expiry date. The extension is granted only if it is requested no later than the pass's expiry date and the pass's extension has not already been used. The request date is compared with the expiry date as calendar dates; a request on the expiry date itself is in time — the latest request day is 0 days before the expiry date. Once granted, the pass shows the extended expiry date and its extension as used.

**Exhausted.** A pass whose last visit is used, forfeited or refunded becomes exhausted.

Whether a pass offers the extension, and its length, is set per pass in the pass terms table.

**Extension conditions — all are read from the pass record**

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| status | active on the request date |
| timing | request date on or before the expiry date |
| once only | the extension has not been used on this pass |
| offered | the pass offers an expiry extension |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, expiry date 30 September, extension length 90 days, extension not used)**

| Request date | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 29 September | granted; new expiry date 29 December |
| 30 September | granted — a request on the expiry date itself is in time; new expiry date 29 December |
| 1 October | not granted — after the expiry date |

The same pass asking a second time after a granted extension is not granted, the extension having been used.
